BackstoryDef.title: Friend of robots
BackstoryDef.description: Isabel grew up shy, finding companionship in comic books and machines. Her robot Sparks became both her first creation and her closest friend.

BackstoryDef.title: Armored idealist
BackstoryDef.description: Inspired by the Mechanist, Isabel built robots to protect people. She worked tirelessly inside her workshop, trusting the reports returned by her machines without seeing the harm their orders caused.
